component.text: Mutations are active behaviors, not decorative labels. They can change symptoms, spread, environmental persistence, treatment resistance and the strength of other mutations.

Some combinations create synergy: respiratory shedding supports air spread, surface persistence supports contact reservoirs, gastrointestinal shedding reinforces consumed transmission, and vaccine-defense traits reduce treatment reliability.
A failed CRISPR program may mutate the source strain. A Random Mutation Vaccine deliberately rolls a mutation and displays the mutation-scroll animation; use it only when the risk is acceptable.
